events.event_name: NEST New York Cardamom Latte Pop-Up
events.address: Chelsea Triangle, W 14th St & 9th Ave, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A one-day fragrance-and-coffee activation for NEST New York's Cardamom Latte Eau de Parfum, with a complimentary café experience in Chelsea Triangle.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary Cardamom Lattes and fragrance sampling are advertised while supplies last.
events.caveats: Multiple current NYC listings agree on Monday, September 14, 10 AM–9 PM at Chelsea Triangle and describe the latte café as complimentary. Promotional drinks and fragrance samples are while supplies last. No RSVP, ticket or organizer-approval requirement is published in the verified sources.
events.practical_notes: Monday, September 14 from 10 AM–9 PM, or while supplies last, at Chelsea Triangle near West 14th Street and Ninth Avenue. Walk in; arrive earlier if the complimentary latte is the priority.

events.address: SVA Theatre, 333 W 23rd St, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A free screening of Timothy Goodman's documentary series about long-time Chelsea Hotel artists, followed by a Q&A with Debbie Millman and featured residents.
events.what_is_free: The screening is free, with drinks, music and live painting listed before the program.
events.caveats: SVA still links to a free RSVP, but the live Partiful currently shows 0 of 530 spots left, 530 going, 226 on the waitlist and states that the event is full. Seating is first come, first served for confirmed attendees. Do not treat a waitlist join as confirmed admission.
events.practical_notes: Monday, September 14. Doors open at 6 PM, screening begins at 7 PM and the Q&A follows around 8 PM. The direct Partiful is currently full with a waitlist.

events.what_it_is: A free immersive bodega-themed pop-up celebrating NYC shop cats, created by TEMPTATIONS with cat-inspired photo moments, merchandise and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Free admission, TEMPTATIONS cat treats and chances to win exclusive merchandise are advertised.
events.caveats: Mars/TEMPTATIONS' release confirms the physical pop-up is free and runs September 17–19 from 12–6 PM daily at 213 Bowery. Treats and merchandise are promotional inventory and may run out. No advance RSVP requirement is published.
events.practical_notes: Thursday through Saturday, September 17–19, 12–6 PM daily at 213 Bowery. Walk-in public activation.

events.address: Robert F. Wagner Jr. Park, 20 Battery Pl, New York, NY 10280
events.what_it_is: A three-night outdoor light-art festival with large-scale installations, projection mapping, DJs, performances, food and drinks at Wagner Park.
events.what_is_free: The organizer's Eventbrite describes the festival as free and open to the public.
events.caveats: The current organizer listing identifies September 17, 18 and 19 as free public festival nights. Food and beverages sold on site are not implied to be free. Outdoor programming may be affected by weather or operational changes.
events.practical_notes: September 17–19, 7–11 PM nightly at Wagner Park. Free/open public festival; no organizer-selection or paid admission requirement is established.

events.event_name: New York Transit Museum Bus Festival
events.brand: New York Transit Museum × MTA New York City Transit
events.address: Emily Warren Roebling Plaza, 1 Water St, Brooklyn, NY 11201
events.what_it_is: The Transit Museum's annual outdoor festival of vintage and contemporary NYC buses, hands-on activities and transit-themed programming.
events.what_is_free: The festival is free, including access to the bus displays and advertised public activities.
events.caveats: Brooklyn Bridge Park confirms the festival is free and runs rain or shine. Advance registration is encouraged but explicitly not required. Buses and equipment on display are subject to change.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 19 from 10 AM–3:30 PM at Emily Warren Roebling Plaza. Walk-ups are allowed; advance registration is optional.

events.event_name: Yepoda × Sephora — The Dewy Day Tour NYC
events.address: Sep 19: 21-27 9th Ave; Sep 20: 40 E 14th St, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A two-stop NYC K-beauty pop-up tour for Yepoda's Sephora launch, with product try-ons, free gifts, prize opportunities and purchase-based gifts with purchase.
events.what_is_free: Eventbrite states that no purchase is necessary to attend and receive freebies. Exclusive free gifts are while supplies last; Sephora gift cards and full-size products are chance-based prizes. Separate GWPs require qualifying purchases.
events.caveats: Yepoda's organizer Eventbrite pages independently confirm both NYC stops and state that attendance/freebies do not require a purchase. Free gifts are while supplies last. Purchase thresholds apply only to the separately advertised gift-with-purchase offers.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 19, 12–6 PM outside Sephora Meatpacking at 21-27 Ninth Avenue. Sunday, September 20, 12–6 PM outside Sephora Union Square at 40 East 14th Street. Use the corresponding Eventbrite page for the stop you plan to attend.
